data.one_liner: A set of method extensions for Dart and Flutter making framework use easier.
data.what_it_does: Provides a large collection of method extensions for common Dart types like String, int, and Iterable, as well as Flutter widgets, contexts, and HTTP requests. It simplifies responsive UI development, list manipulation, and data formatting.
use_when: You want concise syntax for common Dart operations like filtering, grouping, and string manipulation
You want to reduce boilerplate when styling widgets or querying MediaQuery via context
You need basic HTTP helper extensions on strings
avoid_when: You prefer keeping your code free of global or wide-reaching method extensions that pollute namespace
You require a fully-featured robust networking library like Dio instead of basic string HTTP extensions
strengths: Comprehensive collection of utility extensions for standard types and Flutter widgets
Includes responsive UI and sliver extensions
weaknesses: Monolithic extension package covering many unrelated domains (networking, widgets, iterables)
Can pollute auto-complete suggestions with numerous extensions
data.setup_notes: Just add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import where needed.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: For standard, officially supported HTTP client calls without relying on string method extensions.
